dedupeText: post apocalyptic ethereal nature cover overgrown city glowing portal solitary figure nature reclaiming urban ethereal lighting teal and orange palette the glowing white ring acts as a focal point framing the central figure the verticality of the overgrown skyscrapers contrasts with the horizontal plane of the meadow the vibrant green foliage contrasts with the moody dark teal sky combine a post apocalyptic nature reclaiming city scene with a central geometric light portal and high contrast geometric typography positioned in the negative space of the sky

recipe.visualDefinition: A surreal landscape where nature has reclaimed a modern city, featuring a central glowing white ring portal and a lone figure standing in a lush meadow amidst ruins.
coreVisualRelationships: The glowing white ring acts as a focal point, framing the central figure.
The verticality of the overgrown skyscrapers contrasts with the horizontal plane of the meadow.
The vibrant green foliage contrasts with the moody, dark teal sky.
coreInvariants: A perfect circular glowing light source in the center.
Dense green vegetation covering architectural structures.
A solitary human figure viewed from behind or side-profile.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central lone figure, small scale relative to the environment, positioned inside a large glowing ring.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white circular portal in the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the glowing ring, move down to the figure, then outward to the overgrown buildings and the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by a dark, atmospheric sky providing breathing room for the title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and emerald green representing nature and atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the glowing portal and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and orange highlights on the figure's clothing and scattered flowers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the greens; high value contrast between the portal and the dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Custom ligatures or connected strokes between adjacent letters
Open counters and simplified glyph shapes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' lacks a crossbar or uses a stylized bridge
Letters like 'G' and 'N' are simplified into geometric arcs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, stylized display face paired with a clean, widely-spaced light weight sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Wide letter spacing for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Strong geometric presence for the display role

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal landscape with overgrown skyscrapers covered in vines, a lush flower-filled meadow in the foreground, a lone man in a red jacket standing in the center, and a large glowing white neon ring behind him. The sky is a dark, cloudy teal.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a bold, geometric, white uppercase font at the top center. Below it, add a subtitle in a light, widely-spaced white uppercase sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the glowing ring perfectly circular?
Is the text clearly legible against the dark sky?
Does the vegetation look integrated into the buildings?
Is the color palette dominated by teal and green?

adjustableVariables: Amount of cloud cover in the sky
mustRedesign: Exact character ligatures from the original brand

mustAchieve: High contrast between light source and environment

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the glow effect doesn't wash out the central figure.
Verify the tracking on the subtitle is sufficiently wide.
Confirm the composition follows the rule of thirds or central symmetry.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a post-apocalyptic nature-reclaiming-city scene with a central geometric light portal and high-contrast geometric typography positioned in the negative space of the sky.
